full_page.content:
c.1898
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 9
Pg. 11 "It is by thy order O Lord that all irregu- larity of mind should carry its punishment along with it!" St. Austin.
"Before speaking we should communicate our thoughts to God, tell Him what we would say and what reasons we desire to make use of in our discourse, which having done we may ven- ture to speak, and believe by so doing we put God's will in execution, having consulted Him beforehand." St. Ephrem (+379)
"What does well that for which it was made will be favored."
"Pater Noster" - "Noster i.e. totius Ecclesia"
"To live consistent with the discipline requires what, in regards to pleasures?
